model_annotation: This chart illustrates the percentage of BIP (Bruttoinlandsprodukt) by different types of German governmental entities over time. The horizontal axis represents years, ranging from 1995 to 2023, with tick labels at regular five-year intervals. The vertical axis is labeled "% BIP" and displays values ranging from -1.0 to 3.5, with tick labels at regular 0.5 intervals. Three sets of bars are present, each representing a different entity type: "Bund" (federal), "Länder" (states), and "Gemeinden" (municipalities), colored blue, green, and light green respectively. A fourth, black line represents "Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt" (total territorial entities). The bars for "Bund" are consistently the shortest, with a minimum value of approximately -0.5 in 1995 and a maximum value of approximately 1.5 in 2023. "Länder" bars fluctuate, ranging from approximately -1.0 in 1995 to approximately 2.5 in 2023. "Gemeinden" bars also fluctuate, with a minimum value of approximately -0.5 in 1995 and a maximum value of approximately 2.0 in 2023. The bars are sorted chronologically by year, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation.
